notes:
Two fixes for reports on 2.34.0.

DS games could close themselves when you resumed from the SCCM pause menu. DraStic's own
menu is what the launcher pauses with, and a controller press while that menu was up could
close it behind the launcher's back, which turned the resume into a quit. DraStic's menu no
longer takes controller input at all, and resuming is now safe whatever state it is in.

On PSP games, one press of Home opened the SCCM menu and left PPSSPP's own pause menu
sitting behind it, so the game came back with an extra menu on screen. Emulators are no
longer told which button Home is; it belongs to the launcher.

Known rough edges are unchanged from 2.34.0: the DraStic controls are verified by automated
on-console tests but not yet by hand on real pads, and PPSSPP's own pause menu rows are
still unverified.
